title: English Practice Quiz 0169
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: Please drive ___.
questions.explanation: Carefully is the adverb modifying drive.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.
